kendra_intro.speaker: kendra
kendra_intro.text: Warden Kendra, House Duskmere perimeter guard. Stand clear of Pylon Twelve. For the last six hours, it hasn't been relaying the city's broadcast tone—it's been whispering names in a dead dialect.

start_quest.title: The Whispering Pylon
start_quest.desc: Investigate strange auditory emissions radiating from House Duskmere's rim pylon ring.
stages: Report to Warden Kendra at the Duskmere perimeter
Attune to the pylon's dissonant psychic pulse

choices.text: [Arcana Check] That's not speech—it's harmonic cavitation from the cloud-sea planar boundary catching in the crystal matrix.
[Resilience Check] Let me touch the pylon base and ground the accumulating electrostatic charge.
What names is it whispering, Warden?

kendra_explain.speaker: kendra
kendra_explain.text: The names of the outposts lost beyond the cloud-veil. It's frightening the night watchmen, and two initiates refused their posts.

choices.text: We need to bleed the resonant static before the crystal cracks.

kendra_arcana_pass.speaker: kendra
kendra_arcana_pass.text: Cavitation? So the external cloud pressure is forcing an inverted harmonic into the pylon. How do we tune it out?

choices.text: Adjust the ground resonance prongs to phase-cancel the feedback.

kendra_arcana_fail.speaker: kendra
kendra_arcana_fail.text: The whispers are getting louder! The obsidian cap is starting to hum with purple corona discharge!

choices.text: Ground the pylon with a copper tether immediately.

kendra_resilience_pass.speaker: kendra
kendra_resilience_pass.text: You absorbed that entire discharge without flinching! The purple corona has faded to soft blue.

kendra_action.speaker: kendra
kendra_action.text: Hand me the tuning fork. Strike the base on three while I ground the collar.

kendra_resolve.speaker: kendra
kendra_resolve.text: Silence at last. Just the steady, calm hum of the standard city broadcast. The watchmen can return to their stations. Thank you, Voidweaver.
